messages:
Jules PM: we need a concise GA playbook for customer SLA onramps — pilots want 99.99 but with safe rollout. propose token + escrow model. Thoughts?
Rae Eng: token makes sense. implement per-customer state: NONE -> ISSUED -> SOAK -> FULL -> REVOKED. API + audit log required.
Sana SRE: ops gates for SOAK->FULL: 72h soak with synthetic load, no Sev1 for 14d, alerts wired, and automatic revoke on sustained breach.
Maya Sales: customers will accept escrowed credits (cap e.g., 3 months). credits calculate but held until FULL. Partial credits possible in SOAK with cap.
Priya Legal: need exact measurement window (rolling 30d), credit formula, and carve-outs (maintenance, customer misuse, third-party). define who can flip tokens (product + infra lead).
Ben Docs: I'll draft two docs: public explainer for customers and internal activation checklist mapping owners and tickets. ETA 3 days after legal text.
Rae Eng: engineering estimate: state machine + audit API ~1 sprint; router enforcement + reservation tests ~2 sprints.
Sana SRE: monitoring: tag metrics by customer_id+token_state; dashboards for p50/p95/p99, error_rate, slot_util, prewarm_hit. Alert: p99 > 250ms for 10m -> auto-revoke.
infra-bot: Ticket PROD-99990 created: "SLA token + escrow playbook"  assignees: @Rae Eng, @Sana SRE.
Jules PM: GA decision rule: do not advertise 99.99 publicly at GA. enable per-customer token activation; require at least one pilot reach FULL and automation in place. Public cap = 99.95 with upgrade path.
Maya Sales: I'll present the token+escrow offer to pilots and include credit cap language.
Priya Legal: will draft SLA appendix and escrow clause in 48h.
Ben Docs: will PR activation checklist after legal lands.
Rae Eng: starting state-machine PR today and will tag PROD-99990.
Sana SRE: scheduling first soak for next Wed; will attach results.
Jules PM: thanks team. update thread with PRs/tickets. Check-in Friday. :thumbsup:
